newsitem.title: UK: Diana denies taking cash for charity appearances.
newsitem.headline: Diana denies taking cash for charity appearances.

text.p: Princess Diana on Sunday denied accepting cash for charity appearances at home and abroad.
Diana was responding to claims by the tabloid People newspaper that she demanded 200,000 pounds ($312,200) for her charity fundraising appearance in Washington last week.
It said she was also paid 180,000 pounds ($281,000) for a visit to Chicago four months ago to raise money for cancer research.
But a spokeswoman for the princess, divorced last month from heir-to-the-throne Prince Charles, denied the report.

"Diana, Princess of Wales has never requested any payment, nor received any fee, to undertake charity events here or abroad. She has always given her time free and will continue to do so," the spokeswoman said in a statement.
